faqData.q: What is your main area of expertise?
faqData.a: I am an Information Systems fresh graduate from UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur specializing in Data Science, Data Analytics, Business Intelligence (Looker Studio, Power BI, OLAP), and Full-Stack Web Development (Python, Flask, PHP, Laravel, SQL).

faqData.q: What are your notable academic and bootcamp achievements?
faqData.a: I graduated as 3rd Best Graduate of UPN "Veteran" Jawa Timur (Wisuda 98, 2026) with a 3.87 GPA, and as Distinction Graduate & Best Graduate of the Machine Learning Path at Bangkit Academy 2024 Batch 2 (Score 96.8), leading the Top 50 Capstone Project "Tanamore".

faqData.q: What technologies do you use in your projects?
faqData.a: For ML and NLP projects, I use Python, TensorFlow, Keras, IndoBERT, and Flask. For BI and software projects, I work with Looker Studio, Power BI, Pentaho/Mondrian OLAP, MySQL, PHP, Laravel, Kotlin, and Odoo ERP.

faqData.q: Do you have real-world industry and organizational experience?
faqData.a: Yes! I interned at PT PLN (Persero) UP3 Gresik as a Data Analyst & Fullstack Developer, served as an Assistant Lecturer for Programming Language 2, led the Advocacy Department of HIMASIFO UPNVJT, and presented at the Sinergy International Conference 2026.

faqData.q: How can we reach out for opportunities or collaboration?
faqData.a: You can use the contact form above or email me directly at yulianipurwitasari19@gmail.com, or connect via LinkedIn (yuliani-purwitasari) and GitHub (ririsariii).
